snippet.title: STILLTRACE - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
STILLTRACE is a bleak top-down survival horror set in an infected sector.

Leave the safety of the beacon, scavenge for supplies, explore abandoned locations, follow strange radio signals, and reinforce your position with turrets, mines, and other defenses to survive increasingly dangerous attacks.

Some stories won’t wait for you. Some choices may come back later.

🔦 **Wishlist STILLTRACE on Steam:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5115240/STILLTRACE/
